newsitem.title: USA: America Service drops planned acquisition.
newsitem.headline: America Service drops planned acquisition.

text.p: America Service Group Inc said Monday the letter of intent to acquire the privately held correctional health care provider Wexford Health Sources for 1.5 million shares has expired.
America Service also said no future merger discussions are currently planned.

The letter of intent was first announced on December 18, the company noted. On February 28, 1997, it said issues had arisen which warranted re-evaluation of the transaction, that the letter of intent had been extended to allow time for reassessment, and that there could be no assurance that the transaction would be consummated.
America Service also said the companies have jointly bid six new projects. Should these projects be awarded, the companies will operate the projects as joint ventures.
